subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw core ship `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` now, or wait for the Scout/Lobster pilot and RFC to settle whether the durable snapshot surface belongs in core, a host-owned plugin, or both?
rationale: The branch adds a new sensitive backup artifact contract, and the PR body explicitly says the pilot is the operational evidence checkpoint before greenlighting the core path.

options.title: Keep draft pending pilot
options.body: Hold the core command after mechanical cleanup until pilot/RFC evidence confirms the built-in CLI artifact is the right durable surface.

options.title: Sponsor core command after cleanup
options.body: Accept the nested backup command as the Phase 1 local artifact contract once lockfile, startup-policy, and security-review blockers are resolved.

options.title: Move surface to host plugin
options.body: Redirect or close the core command if the pilot shows the host-owned plugin path is sufficient without a new core CLI surface.

recommendation.title: Keep draft pending pilot
recommendation.body: Hold the core command after mechanical cleanup until pilot/RFC evidence confirms the built-in CLI artifact is the right durable surface.

likelyOwner.reason: galiniliev is the current assignee and already reviewed this snapshot invariant, making them the best visible owner for the product-direction call.
